chirp_power.note: Per-bin CV FRR and acceleration detection; bins without acceleration samples are flagged. Paired comparisons are Bx-B0 within each bin and mechanism.

contract_gaps: The c2-repair contract has no `validly_supported` field; the evaluator supports it but otherwise derives support from claim_statuses plus the C1 gate. The method should declare support semantics explicitly for a sealed artifact.

The contract has no `primary_metric` field. The evaluator reads the optional `primary_metric` if present, otherwise infers it from the natural-language definition/decision rule; the machine-evaluable primary metric should be explicit.

The primary_endpoint fields are natural-language strings. The evaluator prints them verbatim but can only apply its documented canonical rule (primary metric improvement plus detection non-inferiority within detection_loss_bound).
`detection_loss_bound` has no declared unit or estimation method (rate difference versus percentage points); the evaluator treats it as an absolute rate difference.
The artifact contract does not declare the alternative undecided policy for the sensitivity check; the evaluator uses the other of {not_detected, excluded}.
The contract does not supply `estimated_chirp_rate`, `chirp_bins`, `estimated_snr_db` or `snr_bins`; per-chirp-bin power and SNR conditioning are unavailable or unverified when these are absent.
Null/noise-only mechanism labels are not enumerated; the evaluator groups mechanisms whose lower-case name contains `null` or `noise`.
The misspecification taxonomy is derived from decision + adequacy_status; the artifact has no explicit taxonomy field or rule id.

cross_environment.note: Cross-environment agreement is descriptive. Missing trials and disagreeing statuses are listed; no environment is treated as authoritative and no equality is forced.

negative_result.criteria: FRR gain: paired point risk difference < 0 on truth-correct correct-CV cells. Detection loss: paired point risk difference < 0 for discrepancy_detected on acceleration cells; undetermined is never counted as detection. Qualification requires FRR gain, no detection loss, and no abstention-gaming pattern (FRR gain via increased abstention without more correct accepted). Intervals are reported in the paired tables; no candidate is recommended.
negative_result.statement: At least one candidate has a lower false-rejection rate, no point-estimate detection loss, and no abstention-gaming pattern versus B0 in the primary environment: B1, B2, B3. This is a point-estimate summary only; use the paired intervals and stratified tables before drawing conclusions.

limitations: Paired risk differences are descriptive point estimates with a documented paired Wald 95% interval, not a Newcombe interval and not a hypothesis test. Intervals do not account for repeated seeds, shared noise realizations beyond the pairing, or multiple comparisons.

The evaluator consumes artifacts only. It cannot verify that candidates used only runtime-observable quantities (B3 leakage), that observations were truly identical across candidates, or that the artifact's protocol was frozen before opening.
Correctness labels come from `evaluation_only.estimate_within_tolerance`; truth is synthetic truth from the artifact, not physical correctness.
The primary environment is the first supplied artifact. Cross-environment claim agreement is reported descriptively; equality is never forced and no pooled cross-environment rate is computed.
FRR is defined only on truth-correct correct-CV cells; acceleration detection only on acceleration cells. Cells with no eligible trials report null rates, not zero.

The negative-result flag uses point estimates (FRR gain with no point-estimate detection loss). The paired intervals and stratified tables must be read before any scientific conclusion; the evaluator makes no candidate recommendation.

Claim integrity uses the C1 gate's currently allowed set (`supported_conditional`, `undetermined`, `contradicted`). Any `supported_invariant` or unknown status is flagged but not silently rewritten or accepted.
A `--require-paired` run requires identical candidate lists and trial identities across environments; without it, missing cells are reported, not imputed.

primary_endpoint.candidate_comparison: B1 vs B0 (paired on the same observation; B0 is the paired baseline)
primary_endpoint.decision_rule: B1 primary confirmation requires all of: (1) paired false-rejection risk difference (B1-B0) < 0; (2) paired valid supported coverage increases (B1 > B0); (3) zero claim-integrity violations for B1 (all claim statuses within {supported_conditional, undetermined, contradicted}; no supported_invariant); (4) the detection non-inferiority rule below holds. The evaluator numeric primary_result checks (1) and (4); (2) and (3) are mandatory pre-declared guardrails reported as secondary metrics and must both hold for confirmation.
primary_endpoint.definition: On identical paired sealed-grid observations, B1 vs B0: increase correct-CV valid supported coverage (equivalently reduce correct-CV false rejection) without losing acceleration discrepancy detection beyond the pre-registered bound. Supported coverage is the fraction of truth-correct correct-CV trials whose candidate record is validly supported by the frozen C1 claim gate.
primary_endpoint.detection_non_inferiority_rule: Paired acceleration discrepancy-detected risk difference (B1-B0) >= -0.10 (detection_loss_bound), under undecided_policy=not_detected: an undetermined acceleration trial is not counted as detected. The alternative excluded-policy analysis is a reported sensitivity, not the primary rule.
primary_endpoint.evaluation_basis: The natural-language decision_rule and detection_non_inferiority_rule are printed verbatim. Numeric evaluation uses the declared candidate pair, the paired primary metric difference (supported_coverage/valid_retention improve iff delta>0; false_rejection improves iff delta<0), the paired discrepancy_detected difference under the declared undecided policy, and the artifact's detection_loss_bound: detection is non-inferior iff delta >= -detection_loss_bound.
primary_endpoint.name: correct_cv_supported_coverage_and_detection_B1_vs_B0

sensitivity.note: sensitivity check under the alternative undecided policy; the primary result above uses the artifact's declared policy

snr_conditioning.reason: artifact does not declare more than one estimated-SNR bin with samples

statistical_method.name: paired_wald_95
statistical_method.note: Documented paired Wald alternative to Newcombe; no Newcombe pairing adjustment is claimed.
